title: Julius Odo-Eke Portfolio Website

title: C.Zara Enterprise Website
description: A four-page website for C.Zara Enterprise, a natural foods business based in Kurudu, Abuja. It introduces the business and its products, tells its story, and gives customers a direct WhatsApp line for enquiries. The site is live on GitHub Pages.
highlights: Home, About Us, Products and Contact pages in one consistent design
Product showcase covering natural honey, cashew nuts, groundnuts and red palm oil
WhatsApp contact built into the header, page calls to action and footer

title: Nethub
description: A multi-page bill-payment platform for airtime, data, TV, electricity, water, betting, education PINs and money transfers, with a customer wallet and an admin control panel. The build is complete. It is waiting for a domain and hosting before it can go live, so there is no public link yet.

title: MedKings Pharmacy Website
description: A pharmacy website I built for a client at medkingspharmacy.com. It is offline at the moment: the owner's cPanel hosting subscription expired and has not been renewed, so the site cannot be visited.
